newsitem.title: UK: Canada's Zicor Mining makes AIM debut.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Zicor Mining makes AIM debut.

text.p: Shares in Canada's Zicor Mining, whose shares trade on the Vancouver Stock Exchange, made their debut on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) on Tuesday.

The shares were marked up at 24-1/2p by 1030 GMT, setting a premium to their issue price of 18p in a placing which raised 850,000 stg before expenses and valued Zicor at 4.14 million stg. No trade was registered in the stock.
The company said the proceeds from the placing would go to fund working capital and to finance expansion in its mining and trading activities.
"I am pleased that we have been able to bring the company to AIM," said chief executive Anthony Rhatigan. "We believe the added profile which this will give the company will be highly beneficial."
In Canada, Zicor's shares have risen by about 50 percent since the AIM listing was announced at the end of January, closing at 0.60 Canadian dollars, around 27p, on February 10.
The sponsor to the AIM listing is Grant Thornton. The broker to the issue was Ellis and Partners.
